d: At Christian Dior Couture, we are more than a Maison. We are a community driven by excellence, creativity, and a deep commitment to people.
We are currently looking for a Boutique Manager to lead one of our boutiques in Bahrain.

This role is not only about managing a store. It is about bringing the Dior vision to life, building a high-performing team, and delivering an exceptional client experience that reflects the standards of the Maison.
As Boutique Manager, you are the leader of the boutique.
You are responsible for driving business performance, developing your team, and ensuring that every client interaction reflects the highest level of luxury service.
You act as a true ambassador of Dior, setting the tone, building a strong team culture, and ensuring excellence in execution across all aspects of the boutique.
q: Lead by example on the floor, delivering exceptional client experience
Develop a strong clienteling culture, ensuring long-term client relationships
Ensure Dior standards are consistently applied across all touchpoints
Build, lead, and inspire a high-performing team
Coach and develop team members, supporting their growth and career progression
Set clear objectives and follow up on performance regularly
Foster a strong team spirit and a culture of accountability
Ensure smooth daily operations across all areas: merchandising, stock, VM, security, and housekeeping
Oversee inventory processes and ensure accuracy
Maintain strong control on stock management and minimize losses
Ensure full compliance with company policies and procedures
Lead regular team briefings to review performance and share key updates
Ensure clear and consistent communication with all stakeholders
Act as a link between the boutique and the wider organization
Minimum 5 years of experience in luxury retail
Strong understanding of the luxury environment and client expectations
Commercial mindset with a strong sense of ownership
Natural leader with the ability to engage, develop, and challenge teams
Well-organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through
Flexible and available to support the business when needed
r: Drive and exceed annual sales targets, ensuring strong commercial performance
Monitor KPIs and take clear actions to improve results
Identify opportunities to grow the business and strengthen the boutique’s position in the market
